meta.description: Extended F2L case library — all case families beyond the standard 41 + 54 AF2L
notes: Jeff2L: neither piece is in the U layer, at least one is in a wrong slot
All setups assume white cross on bottom, FR is the target slot unless noted
Open slot cases assume the FL slot is empty (the extra free slot)
WV/SV: last-slot cases that also orient last-layer corners
corner_orientation codes: U=white up, F=white front/facing you, R=white right

R U2 R' U' R U R' U' R U' R'

cases.label: Corner below in D layer (unlikely but possible in first solve)
algs: R' D R U2 R' D' R
D R U R' D' R U' R'

last_slot_edge_only.description: ELS (Edge Last Slot) / VHF2L — the last F2L corner is already solved. Only the edge needs inserting. Some variants also orient LL edges.

cases.label: Edge in U oriented correctly, corner solved — simple edge insert
algs: U' F' U F
y' U R' U' R
cases.note: Don't disturb the solved corner — use F or back-side moves only.

cases.label: Edge in U flipped, corner solved
algs: F' U' F U F' U' F
U R' F R F' R' F R F'

cases.label: Edge in U, needs AUF before insert, corner solved
algs: F' U2 F
y' R' U2 R

cases.label: Edge in wrong slot flipped, corner solved — must extract without touching corner
algs: F' L F L' R U' R'
U R' F R F' R' F R F' R U' R'

cases.label: Edge in wrong slot oriented, corner solved
algs: L U' L' R U' R'
F L F' L' U' F' U F

cases.label: Edge in BL slot, corner solved — diagonal edge wrong slot
algs: R2 U L U' L' R2
y' R U' R' U L' U L

xcross_cases.description: XCross cases — the first F2L pair is solved simultaneously with the cross. These are recognition patterns, not separate alg sets, but Codex needs to know they exist.

cases.label: XCross — FR pair insertes during the last cross edge
cases.example_setup: F R U R' U' F'
algs: F R U R' U' F'
U R' F R F' U R U' R'
cases.note: This is a planning case, not a distinct alg — the pair is assembled during cross solving.

cases.label: XCross — pair formed during cross via lucky pair skip
algs: R U' R'
cases.note: 0-move F2L. After cross, the FR pair is already solved.

cases.label: XCross double — two pairs solved during cross
cases.example_setup: F U R U' R' U R U' R' F'
algs: F U R U' R' U R U' R' F'
cases.note: Extremely rare. Recognized during inspection.

damage_control.description: Cases where a previously solved pair has been accidentally disrupted during F2L, or where moves are needed to fix a global F2L mistake without restarting.

cases.label: One solved pair accidentally popped out during an F2L alg
algs: R U' R' (re-insert, then continue)
F' U F (re-insert other side)
cases.note: Intuitive recovery — recognise which pair is out, bring it back with minimum moves.

cases.label: Two solved pairs disrupted — use D-layer to restore order
algs: D R U R' D'
D2 R U' R' D2
cases.note: D-layer rotation to re-align and re-insert two disrupted pairs.

cases.label: Wrong pair was solved — need to remove it without fully undoing the solve
algs: R U R' (pop pair)
U2 (AUF)
re-insert correct pair
cases.note: Extract the wrong pair, use an AUF, and insert the correct one.

cases.label: F2L pair solved into wrong slot — entire pair is correct but in wrong position
cases.setup: D R' U R D'
algs: D R' U' R D'
y2 R U R' U' R U' R'
cases.note: Extract pair from wrong slot using D move, re-insert into correct slot.

cases.label: Pair solved correctly but edge is flipped — need to fix edge orientation
cases.setup: R U R' U' R U R' F R' F' R
algs: R' F R F' U' R U' R' U R U R'
F R U R' U' F' R U R'
cases.note: Dedicated alg to flip the edge in-slot without displacing the corner.
